description: This file contains utility functions for handling Android boot images, including packing and unpacking ramdisks, generating boot images, and extracting Android version info from boot images. It interacts with external tools like mkbootfs, lz4, and mkbootimg, and manages vendor-specific boot image modifications.

methods.name: RunMkBootFs
methods.description: Creates a cpio filesystem image from a directory using mkbootfs.

methods.name: ExtractValue
methods.description: Extracts a value associated with a key from a string formatted as a dictionary.

methods.name: DeleteTmpFileIfNotChanged
methods.description: Deletes a temporary file if it has not changed compared to the current file.

methods.name: RepackVendorRamdisk
methods.description: Recreates a vendor ramdisk by unpacking, stripping modules, and concatenating.

methods.name: PackRamdisk
methods.description: Creates a ramdisk image from a directory.

methods.name: UnpackRamdisk
methods.description: Extracts a ramdisk image into a directory.

methods.name: IsCpioArchive
methods.description: Checks if a file is a cpio archive by reading its magic number.

methods.name: GetAvbMetadataFromBootImage
methods.description: Extracts AVB metadata from a boot image.

methods.name: UnpackBootImage
methods.description: Unpacks a boot image into a directory, extracting parameters.

methods.name: UnpackVendorBootImageIfNotUnpacked
methods.description: Unpacks a vendor boot image if not already unpacked.

methods.name: RepackBootImage
methods.description: Recreates a boot image with a new kernel and ramdisk, adding AVB hash footer.

methods.name: RepackVendorBootImage
methods.description: Recreates a vendor boot image with a new ramdisk and parameters, adding AVB hash footer.

methods.name: RepackVendorBootImageWithEmptyRamdisk
methods.description: Recreates a vendor boot image with an empty ramdisk.

methods.name: RepackGem5BootImage
methods.description: Creates a boot image for Gem5 with custom ramdisks and bootconfig.

methods.name: ReadAndroidVersionFromBootImage
methods.description: Reads the Android OS version from a boot image by unpacking and parsing boot parameters.
